# Problem 1. Giant kelp fronds 

## a. 

To determine the strength of the relationship between temperature and giant kelp frond elongation, you need to conduct a Pearson's correlation test and Spearman rank correlation test.  A Pearson's correlation test is a parametric test that analyzes a linear relationship between continuous variables that are normally distributed (debatable).  On the other hand, a Spearman rank correlation test is the non-parametric version that looks as a monotonic relationhsip between variables that have independently observed samples.
